macro.headline: Bull regime intact but momentum cooling — rotation matters more than index direction
macro.story:
The tape is in a transitional posture. SPY, QQQ, the Dow, and the Russell are all above their 50- and 200-day moving averages and the broader bull regime is intact (SPY just 0.5% off its 52-week high), but daily momentum has rolled over on the major indices — MACD has turned bearish on SPY, QQQ, and the Nasdaq, and SPY printed a -1.25% day on Tuesday. The VIX sits at 17.36 and has actually fallen ~11% over the past five sessions, so this is a controlled pullback inside an uptrend, not a stress event. Engine C's washout state is CALM with RSI at 50.75, well above any timing trigger.

The dominant catalyst we can name from the active themes is the AI Infrastructure capex cycle, which the theme tracker has flagged as CHASING — institutional capital is concentrating into the mega-cap compute stack while precious metals (gold -5% over 21 days, silver -10%) and the broader hedge complex bleed out. DXY pushing into overbought (RSI 69.5) reinforces the classic dollar-up / metals-down setup, which is a validated inverse relationship and a real headwind for gold and silver longs here. Layer on the Geopolitical Risk Unwind theme — WTI is down ~31% over 21 days as the crude risk premium drains — and you have a cross-asset story where lower oil and a stronger dollar are quietly subsidizing equity multiples even as the index averages digest.

Under the surface the rotation has shifted away from pure tech leadership: Industrials, Financials, Materials, and Healthcare are all in HOT momentum states with bullish MACD, while Technology is QUALIFYING with a bearish MACD cross and Communication Services and Energy are outright WEAK. That is a classic mid-cycle rotation pattern — leadership broadening into cyclicals and quality defensives while the prior leaders consolidate. For long-only execution, this argues for hunting in the validated Early-Runway industries rather than chasing the index.

Confidence is MEDIUM, not HIGH: price structure and VIX are constructive, but daily MACD is bearish across the major indices and the 10Y-2Y spread is compressing again. We are buyers of validated setups, not buyers of the tape.
